- Playwright MCP tools load with ToolSearch `select:mcp__playwright__browser_*`; reload per session.
- The mock is stateless. Dialog open GETs are the dialog's option lists, not cancel requests.

- Stacked XHR hooks log every request twice; clear `window.__log` before the step.
- Permission layer denies: bash for-loops with variables, shell redirects into run-artifacts/, compound commands with quotes/braces. Use one plain command per call.
- index.html has two pre-paint background literals (#fcfcfd, #121214). Outside the colour grep scope; documented as an exception in frontend/README.md.

- Build: `cd frontend && npx ng build` (about 30 s; prints the budget WARNING).

- Servers (repo root, one per call): `scripts/mock.sh start --port 4010`, `scripts/frontend.sh start --api http://localhost:4010 --port 4300`. Stop: `scripts/frontend.sh stop --port 4300`, `scripts/mock.sh stop --port 4010`. Currently stopped.
- Theme: `document.querySelector('[data-testid="theme-option-dark"]').click()`; storage key `qf.theme`.
- Clock: `window.__qfClock.setNow('2026-10-15T09:30:00Z')`.
- Nav in evaluate: `document.querySelector('[data-testid="nav-tasks"]').click()`, then wait ~900 ms.
EOF
